decisive_items: A core-needle biopsy of the left breast confirmed infiltrative duct cell carcinoma that was estrogen- and progesterone-receptor positive.

Fine-needle aspiration cytology of the left breast lump revealed poorly cohesive clusters of ductal cells with pleomorphism, hyperchromasia, and prominent nucleoli; myoepithelial cells and bare nuclei were absent.
response.rationale: Left breast lesion is definitively diagnosed as infiltrative ductal carcinoma by core biopsy and cytology, while right breast lump is only suspected fibroadenoma based on physical exam and cytology without confirmatory biopsy.

rejected.why: Right breast lump was only suspected fibroadenoma; cytology showed atypical features and no confirmatory biopsy, so it is not the most likely overall diagnosis.
